seoTitle: Prefab Container Homes │ Configured Single & Colony │ SAMAN
metaDescription: Prefab container homes built new to container dimensions in six sizes from 20x8 to 40x12 ft. Structural warranty included, delivered across India in 7 to 21 working days.
opener: Prefab container homes from SAMAN are the repeatable-module build in our container house range: identical factory modules with sealed connection details, standard kitchen and bathroom service routes, and an expansion-ready end wall. That repeatability is the point, one drawing produces one home or a colony of twenty without redesign. Prices run from Rs 2,59,520 ex-GST for the 20x8 ft module to Rs 6,51,360 for the 40x12 ft, across six sizes. Walls are corrugated MS over 75 mm mineral wool with a 100 mm glasswool roof layer, and every module is made in our Bengaluru and Greater Noida works.
descriptionHtml:
Each prefab container home is newly fabricated in container form at our works; no used cargo shell is involved unless you separately request a converted-container quotation.

5-year structural warranty and 1-year finishing warranty as standard; finishing warranty extendable to 2 years on request, confirmed at quotation. Typical service life is 20 to 25 years under proper use and maintenance, which is an engineering expectation, not a warranty period.

the full container house range
materialLabel: corrugated MS over 75 mm mineral wool
priceCaption: Published prices are ex-factory for the unit as specified, exclusive of GST. Foundation, site levelling, water and drainage connection and the electrical service point are arranged at your site and are quoted separately.
trustWarranty: 5-year structural warranty and 1-year finishing warranty as standard
